title: Distribution and steward-hook consume @inventarch/workspace-runtime
summary: @inventarch/distribution and @inventarch/steward-hook import the generic workspace runtime from @inventarch/workspace-runtime and no longer depend on @inventarch/agent-composition-system. The installed implementation identity they pin now hashes @inventarch/workspace-runtime under its own name instead of @inventarch/agent-composition-system, so a retained context-hook binding refuses with "Installed hook implementation changed" until the lifecycle hook is registered again, and a projection published before the upgrade no longer checks as current until its descriptor is re-pinned to the new implementation digest and it is published again; behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
